decks.notes: This deck focuses on assembling a fast combo win without relying on traditional land cards. By using powerful cards like Flare of Denial and Disrupting Shoal to control the opponent's plays, combined with cards like Thundertrap Trainer and Hydroelectric Specimen to generate advantage, the deck aims to set up a lethal finisher with Goblin Charbelcher. The inclusion of cards like Whir of Invention and Tameshi, Reality Architect offer additional flexibility and consistency to the combo strategy, while protecting it with counters like Pact of Negation and Force of Negation.

The main concept of the deck is to ramp up mana quickly using cards like Arboreal Grazer and Amulet of Vigor, while also utilizing Primeval Titan to search for key lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Urza's Saga. The deck aims to create a powerful combo by using cards like Scapeshift to deal massive damage with lands entering the battlefield. Additionally, cards like Dryad of the Ilysian Grove and The One Ring provide additional utility and versatility to the deck, allowing for various strategic options and win conditions.

This deck relies on using various cards to quickly assemble the Broodscale Bloodchief combo, which involves combining Blade of the Bloodchief with Basking Broodscale to create a powerful, synergistic engine. The deck's strategy revolves around generating mana quickly through cards like Springleaf Drum and Kozilek's Command, while also controlling the board through cards like Malevolent Rumble and Walking Ballista. The presence of cards like Spellskite and Cavern of Souls helps protect the combo and ensure its success, making it a formidable force in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

This deck focuses on assembling a combo using various spells and creatures without relying on lands for mana. Key cards include Beyeen Veil, Goblin Charbelcher, and Thundertrap Trainer to disrupt opponents and protect the combo. The goal is to generate mana quickly with Lotus Bloom and Whir of Invention to cast powerful spells like Pact of Negation and Commandeer. The deck aims to control the game with counterspells like Disrupting Shoal and halt opponents' strategies with cards like Sink into Stupor and Suppression Ray. It's all about fast-paced, landless combo play.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with a combination of aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Bonecrusher Giant, and Amped Raptor, supported by powerful enchantments like Static Prison and The One Ring. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Blood Moon and Goblin Bombardment to disrupt opponent's strategies. With Ajani, Nacatl Pariah as a finisher and Ocelot Pride providing extra utility, this deck aims to maintain board control and deal fast damage to secure victory in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on utilizing efficient and aggressive creatures, spells, and artifacts in combination with powerful support cards to overwhelm the opponent quickly. By utilizing a combination of creature aggression, direct damage, and disruption, the deck aims to establish early board presence and apply continuous pressure on the opponent to close out the game before they can stabilize. The inclusion of companions allows for additional synergy and flexibility in adapting to different matchups, while the main deck cards provide a well-rounded strategy for consistent success in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

The main concept of the deck is to quickly establish a board presence with aggressive creatures like Amped Raptor and Ocelot Pride, supported by other creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The deck aims to control the opponent's board with cards like Static Prison and finish the game quickly with powerful cards like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury. The inclusion of Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and The One Ring provide additional threats and support to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also benefits from the ramp and fixing provided by Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion.

The deck focuses on building a strong aggressive board presence with efficient creatures like Ragavan and Phlage, while also utilizing burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge for direct damage. The inclusion of Goblin Bombardment adds reach and versatility. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Static Prison and Guide of Souls, and generate card advantage with Expressive Iteration and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah. The mana base is focused on consistency and flexibility, with fetch lands and shock lands to ensure all colors can be accessed easily.

This deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands to generate a large amount of mana to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Emrakul, the Promised End and Thought-Knot Seer. The deck also includes cards that can disrupt the opponent's game plan, such as All Is Dust and Karn, the Great Creator, while providing card advantage with The Underworld Cookbook. The goal is to control the board and overwhelm the opponent with high-impact threats.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by using a variety of counterspells and removal spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The Elemental creatures in the deck provide value and card advantage, while also synergizing with other cards such as Risen Reef and Omnath, Locus of Creation. The deck also includes a companion, Kaheera, the Orphanguard, which adds an additional creature to the board and offers more synergy with the Elemental theme. By efficiently controlling the board and out-valuing the opponent, this deck aims to gradually outpace and overwhelm them.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays using creatures like Amped Raptor, Guide of Souls, and Orcish Bowmasters to quickly take down the opponent. It also utilizes direct damage spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to control the board and finish off opponents. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of versatility to the deck. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Thoughtseize and Static Prison to disrupt opponents' strategies and give this aggro deck an edge in matches.

The key concept of this deck is to play aggressively with small, fast creatures like Guide of Souls, Ocelot Pride, and Amped Raptor to quickly deal damage to the opponent. Using cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury can help provide additional support and damage. The deck also includes control elements like Static Prison and Galvanic Discharge to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional synergy and benefits to the deck. Overall, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient creatures and spells.

This Jeskai Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a combination of efficient creatures and burn spells. The goal is to maintain a fast pace of aggression while controlling the board with cards like Static Prison. The deck also utilizes Expressive Iteration for card advantage and disruption. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an additional element of consistency to the deck. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to apply constant pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing Leylines and Leyline of the Guildpact to support powerful multicolored creatures like Scion of Draco and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury. By playing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Territorial Kavu, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with tribal synergy and efficient removal like Tribal Flames and Lightning Bolt. The companion Jegantha, the Wellspring adds consistency and versatility to the deck, allowing for additional mana ramp options. Overall, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan with a mix of creature-based aggression and spell-based removal.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo utilizing cards like Lotus Bloom, Thundertrap Trainer, and Goblin Charbelcher to deal massive damage to the opponent. By utilizing counter spells like Pact of Negation and Disrupting Shoal, as well as disruption cards like Sink into Stupor and Suppression Ray, the deck aims to control the game and protect its combo pieces. The deck's win condition revolves around casting a high number of spells in a turn to activate Goblin Charbelcher's ability, resulting in a devastating blow to the opponent.

This deck focuses on controlling the board through counterspells and removal while also utilizing powerful Elemental creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Risen Reef to generate advantage. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while gradually building up its own board presence to eventually overwhelm the opponent. The inclusion of Kaheera, the Orphanguard as a companion provides additional synergy and support for the Elemental tribal theme. The mana base is carefully crafted to ensure consistent color access for the deck's powerful spells and creatures.
